_readme: NON-SECRET configuration template for the Local Training Bridge V1. Copy to bridge_config.json only if you need to override defaults. NEVER put TRAINING_BRIDGE_SECRET, api_key, tokens, or passwords in this file: the bridge refuses to start if it finds one. Secrets come only from environment variables / process memory.

run_defaults._note: Provider/model are chosen LOCALLY. The Site can only send duration_hours and api_reference_percent. The model provider API key stays on this machine and is entered through the local dashboard.

_cors_note: Leave empty. The bridge is called by the Site SERVER, not by browser JavaScript, so browser CORS is unnecessary. Access-Control-Allow-Origin is never set to '*'. If you ever need a temporary direct browser test, set exactly one full origin such as 'https://your-site.example' and clear it afterwards.
